title: Enter gets clearer places for everything
summary:
A new Llama model and a more navigable Enter sit atop a substantial move of text generation into Gen.

Enter’s dashboard was reorganized into News & FAQ, Pollen, Usage, Keys, and Models pages, with mobile navigation and shared UI components. API keys and app keys now have separate lists, and News and FAQ share one Updates page.

Meta Llama 3.3 70B Instruct was added as `llama`, with tool use and a 131,072-token context window. Separate fixes address rejected Claude requests, empty-message errors, Gemini audio token details, and `nova-fast` model resolution.

Gen’s Worker now handles chat completions, `/text` requests, streaming, and related text-model behavior previously served separately. Legacy Enter generation URLs gained redirects to their Gen counterparts, preserving query strings and POST requests.

highlights.title: Llama 3.3 70B
highlights.text: Use `llama` for text generation with tool use and a 131,072-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama).

highlights.title: A clearer Enter dashboard
highlights.text: Find News & FAQ, Pollen, Usage, Keys, and Models in dedicated pages, with mobile navigation and separate lists for API keys and app keys. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: Text joins the Gen Worker
highlights.text: Send chat completions and `/text` requests through Gen’s unified API, including streaming responses. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
